attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Medical malpractice lawsuits have increased the cost of healthcare for everyone by prompting physicians to practice defensive medicine through tests and treatments that might otherwise be optional.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Rural America is especially affected by increased healthcare costs because obstetricians, surgeons, and other providers move to urban settings or retire in the face of escalating insurance premiums.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Many Republican Governors have advanced legal reforms to reverse the trend of providers leaving rural areas.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for state and federal legislation to cap non-economic damages in medical malpractice lawsuits.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Capping non-economic damages in medical malpractice lawsuits would relieve conscientious providers of burdens.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Capping non-economic damages in medical malpractice lawsuits would address a serious cause of higher medical bills.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
